locus.output_selection: tensor output of the linear language_projection over the Q-Former's 128 query tokens, (B, 128, 4096)
locus.token_rule: all 128 query tokens; the Q-Former is a perceiver-style resampler, so the token count is fixed and independent of the image
locus.affected_branch: the 128 visual embeddings concatenated in front of the prompt embeddings
locus.notes: the Q-Former takes no text input (query_embeds only), so the connector is prompt-independent
